content.full_text: HTW Berlin - University of Applied Sciences - studies, research, further education International Pathways Abroad Studying abroad Studying abroad Spending time abroad at one of our 170 partner universities is a great way to offers a new study experience and is a great way to get to know to foreign culture, its people and everyday life. Experience abroad will also expand your horizon and help you to create a strong individual profile. We will gladly advise you on the many options for studying abroad and provide support with the organisation. You can read all the information about studying abroad in this presentation , as well as in our guide . Please contact us at the following email address outgoing-students@htw-berlin.de ... or use one of our consultation service: Monday: 10:00 a.m. - 1:00 p.m.: personal consultation, building A, room 112 (International Office campus Treskowallee) Wednesday: 10:00 a.m. - 12:00 p.m. (by phone) Thursday: 1:00 p.m. - 4:00 p.m. (campus Wilhelminenhof, building B, room 004) → cancelled on 29.01./05.02./12.02.2026 For telephone advice on Wednesday you can reach us via phone: +49 30 5019 - 3155 No prior appointment is required.
